summary: Iter45 covers: (1) GET /api/wallet/video-sessions grouping + pagination, (2) resume+exhausted budget errors, (3) /video/stop reason enum + bogus 404, (4) /video/start {resume:true} on bogus 404, (5) DB-seeded end-to-end resume flow (incl. billed>>max → 400 'Sisa waktu'), (6) scheduler social_tick creating next weekly occurrence with repeat_label + /scheduled/{jid}/stop-repeat endpoint, (7) chat._schedule_utc 4-tuple roll-forward unit, (8) Frontend /wallet tabbed Riwayat (wallet-history, wallet-tab-calls|video|txns, video-call-*, video-session-*), (9) /social social-scheduled card still renders, (10) Home/chat loads cleanly with the Oryntix support avatar — no console errors from SupportVideo.jsx/avatarVideo.js on page load.
critical_code_review_comments: support_agent._close_stale_video uses `updated_at` fallback to `created_at`; a session that is < 45s old during a legitimate reconnect raises 409 'Video sudah aktif di panggilan ini'. The resume flow therefore depends on the previous session being marked ended with DISCONNECTED/STALE — ensure the frontend reliably POSTs /video/stop with reason=DISCONNECTED before invoking resume.

social.schedule_post: when caller passes meta containing series_id, the code uses `job.get('series_id') or job['id']` AFTER inserting job id — this works but is fragile. _schedule_next passes series_id via meta so it is preserved; OK.
wallet.video_session_report queries only video_sessions, which means a seeded realtime_call without video_sessions would not appear — this is intended per spec (video sessions grouped per call).
seed_data_creation: All seeded docs (realtime_calls t-call-1, video_sessions t-vs-1 + any active child, social_schedules series) were cleaned up in try/finally of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter45.py disables xdist via -o addopts="" because /app/backend/pytest.ini forces loadscope parallelism. Login page has two 'Masuk' buttons (Google + submit) — use get_by_role('button', name='Masuk').last to click the gradient submit.
